Only announced, reserved pools award prizes. Records start in review; an operator checks eligibility and arranges delivery. Game credits cannot be redeemed.

    Hourly contest rules

    Rule version: hourly-independent-reset-v4. Each GMT hour has a fresh 1,000-credit starting balance across all instruments, intervals, and directions. Settled payouts return to your balance and can be spent again during the same hour. Unused credits do not carry forward. The game uses hourly contests only. Daily contests are disabled.

    Your final score is ending credits minus the initial 1,000, equal to settled returns minus costs. Pending entries remain provisional. The highest final net tally wins, even if all tallies are negative. Ties share first place. Hours with no entries have no winner. Intervals ending at HH:00 belong to the hour just ended.

    At each GMT hour boundary, every player receives a fresh 1,000 credits. Previous winnings do not carry forward. Final results and winners are saved after all segments settle. Missing price history delays the winner, without delaying the next hour’s credits; results are never invented. Hours stay aligned to GMT (UTC+00:00), without daylight-saving shifts.

    Only announced gift-card pools award prizes, subject to operator eligibility review and delivery. Tied winners split the pool; leftover cents go in account-ID order. Game credits are not redeemable for cash. Historical records retain their original rule version and are not recalculated under the new allowance.
